description: Part of t5109-fresh (pending since #4123): sheet CdfWide rows 32-37 (and its header row 1), plus the Precision sheet. The whole t5109-fresh workbook failed twice on excel-graph (Graph's calculate or createSession, retries exhausted; #4124), so docs/research/probe-handoff-2026-11-11-wave2.md splits it into one workbook per sheet, with each HYPGEOM.DIST cdf row over 2^17 summed terms in groups of at most 6 rows. Sheet names, cell addresses and formulas are t5109-fresh's, so its frozen predictions apply cell for cell. t5109-fresh: T-5109 and T-2481 fresh sweep (decision 0188 R4.2), generated 2026-11-10 after the whole-count Loader kernel and the hypergeometric cdf were frozen. Sheet Calc (seed "r4-T-5109"): interior BINOM.DIST pmf (n log-uniform to 1E9), saddle-point POISSON.DIST pmf (k log-uniform to 1E9) and in-support HYPGEOMDIST / HYPGEOM.DIST pmf (population log-uniform to 2^31 - 2), literal arguments of at most 15 significant digits. Sheet Poisson (seed "r4-T-2481"): k from 1E4 to 1E15 with the mean within a few to thirty standard deviations of k, the inputs in cells. Sheet Closed: HYPGEOMDIST tuples with x = successes, where the factor BINOM.DIST(x, successes, p) is the closed form p^x and a subnormal that the engine keeps (G, with its (cell)=0 companion H): E is a normal double only if Excel keeps it too. Sheet Cdf: 60 HYPGEOM.DIST(..,TRUE) points, x within four standard deviations of the mean. Sheet CdfWide (seed "r4-T-2481-wide"): 66 HYPGEOM.DIST(..,TRUE) points at populations from 2E7 to 2^31 - 2 with draws and successes between 5% and 95% of the population (a standard deviation of 600 to 11,585), x at the mean and 0.5, 1, 2 and 4 standard deviations either side: beyond every cached cdf cell (standard deviation at most 602, products of the ratio below 2^53). Sheet CdfTie (seed "r4-T-2481-tie"): near-ties of the mirror test, x N = n K + 1, - 1 and 0 with products above 2^53, where the two branches differ by a few hundred ulp. Column B or D or I is the (cell)=0 companion (decision 0042). Frozen model values: docs/research/t5109-fresh-predictions.json. Predictions are hypotheses, NOT expected values. Precision!B2:B4 must retain 0.9999999999999998, 1, 1.0000000000000002; C2:C4 must be -1,0,1.
